record.paper_title: Open problems on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
record.original_question: Let C be a simple planar closed curve of length L bounding a planar domain D. Does there exist a constant-mean-curvature H-surface with boundary C when H = L/(2|D|)? If such a surface exists, what geometric properties must it have?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.2. Let C be a simple planar closed curve. Is there a H-surface bounded by C where H=L/(2|D|)? What can be said about the geometry of this surface?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C \subset \mathbb{R}^2 \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a simple closed planar curve of length $L$, and let $D$ be the bounded planar domain enclosed by $C$, with area $|D|$. A compact immersed surface $M \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ with boundary $\partial M = C$ is called an $H$-surface if it has constant mean curvature equal to $H$. Set the critical value
$$H_0 \;=\; \frac{L}{2|D|}.$$
(i) Does there exist a compact immersed $H_0$-surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$ whose boundary is $C$?

(ii) If such an $H_0$-surface exists, what geometric properties (e.g. embeddedness, topology, symmetry, position relative to the plane of $C$, and relation to the planar disk $D$) must it possess?
artifact.category_tag: Constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
artifact.status_search_result: General searches on CMC surfaces with prescribed planar boundary surface the well-known fact that the value $H = L/(2|D|)$ is the critical/limit case for existence (the planar disk itself realizes the boundary at $H=0$, and existence for $|H|$ up to this critical value is the principal open question even for the circle). No source was located that resolves existence at the critical value $H = L/(2|D|)$ for general simple planar curves, indicating the problem remains open.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces in Euclidean space (López, survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses existence/nonexistence of H-surfaces spanning a planar Jordan curve and the role of the isoperimetric-type bound H ≤ L/(2|D|).
status_evidence.claim: Existence of CMC surfaces bounded by a planar curve up to the critical value L/(2|D|) is highlighted as an open question.

status_evidence.title: Constant Mean Curvature Surfaces with Boundary (Springer book by R. López)
status_evidence.snippet: Monograph surveying open problems on CMC surfaces with prescribed boundary, including critical mean curvature existence.
status_evidence.claim: The critical case for prescribed planar boundary is identified as an open problem.
